verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.context.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as .md pages, and a second llms.txt exists at www.context.dev. Agent-oriented material includes an installable coding-agent skill, an agent auth flow (auth.md), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
